# API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-api-docs.mjs from the code. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:api`. -->

Base URL: `/api/v1` (the health check is `/health`). 485 endpoints.
Interactive documentation: `/api/docs` (Swagger UI, not in production unless `SWAGGER_ENABLED=true`).
Machine-readable: [`docs/api/openapi.json`](api/openapi.json); Postman: [`docs/api/ROF-LMS.postman_collection.json`](api/ROF-LMS.postman_collection.json).

**Conventions.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`).
Lists return `{ data, meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }` with `?page=&limit=` (max 100).
Errors return `{ statusCode, error, code, message, details?, requestId }`; branch on `code`.
Unknown body or query fields are rejected (`VALIDATION_FAILED`).

## Academic years

### GET `/api/v1/academic-years`

**Access:** STUDENT, TEACHER, MENTOR, HEAD_COACH, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

All academic years (newest first), e.g. for filters.

Returns `200` JSON, an array of objects with:

`_count` object · `closedAt` any or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `endsOn` string (date-time) · `id` string (uuid) · `isCurrent` boolean · `name` string · `startsOn` string (date-time) · `status` string · `updatedAt` string (date-time)

**Access:** STUDENT, TEACHER, MENTOR, HEAD_COACH, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Returns `200` JSON with:

`closedAt` any or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `endsOn` string (date-time) · `id` string (uuid) · `isCurrent` boolean · `name` string · `startsOn` string (date-time) · `status` string · `updatedAt` string (date-time)

### POST `/api/v1/admin/academic-years/{id}/activate`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Start the year: closes the current one (archiving its assignments) and
rolls every active student over — promoted one grade when requested.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `promoteStudents` | boolean | ✓ | Move every active student up one grade (true at the start of a new school year). |
| `deactivateGraduates` | boolean |  | When promoting, deactivate S6 students who graduate (default true). |
| `expectedCurrentYearId` | string (uuid) | ✓ | REQUIRED: the academic year the caller saw as current (null: none). When the current year is now another one (another start went through meanwhile), the start is refused with 409 CURRENT_YEAR_CHANGED instead of closing a year the caller never saw and rolling students over a second time. Required so that no client can start a year blind. |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`academicYear` object · `assignmentsArchived` integer · `carriedOver` integer · `graduated` integer · `newlyEnrolled` integer · `promoted` integer

Returns `200` JSON with:

## Admin · Bulk operations

### POST `/api/v1/admin/bulk/{entityType}`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Starts the action on exactly the previewed records: 202 with the operation (200 with the same operation when the
idempotencyKey was already used). 409 SELECTION_CHANGED, 410 CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED, 403 CONFIRMATION_WRONG_ADMINISTRATOR,
400 CONFIRMATION_INVALID, 409 CONFIRMATION_USED (a confirmation creates one operation).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `entityType` | path | string | ✓ | A record type (GET /admin/bulk/actions), e.g. USER. |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `action` | string | ✓ | One of the record type's actions (GET /admin/bulk/actions). |
| `params` | object |  | The action's parameters (validated with the record type's parameter rules). |
| `selection` | object | ✓ |  |
| `selectionToken` | string | ✓ | The confirmation from the preview (opaque; 15 minutes; bound to you, the action, its parameters and the exact records). |
| `expectedTotal` | number | ✓ | The total the administrator confirmed (secondary check). |
| `confirm` | boolean | ✓ | Must be true: the administrator confirmed the action. |
| `idempotencyKey` | string | ✓ | The same key returns the same operation; nothing is done twice. |
| `reason` | string |  | Required (3–500 characters) when the action's requiresReason is true. |
| `currentPassword` | string |  | Required when the preview said requiresStepUp (checked, never stored). |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`operation` object · `alreadyExisted` boolean

### POST `/api/v1/admin/bulk/{entityType}/export`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

CSV of the selected records (record types with an export; safe fields only). Audited.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `entityType` | path | string | ✓ | A record type (GET /admin/bulk/actions), e.g. USER. |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `selection` | object | ✓ |  |

Returns `200`: CSV file (UTF-8 with BOM), sent as an attachment; the record type decides the columns (USER: never dates of birth or phone numbers).

### POST `/api/v1/admin/bulk/{entityType}/preview`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

What the action would do now (count, sample, warnings, consequences) and the 15-minute confirmation. Changes nothing.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `entityType` | path | string | ✓ | A record type (GET /admin/bulk/actions), e.g. USER. |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `action` | string | ✓ | One of the record type's actions (GET /admin/bulk/actions). |
| `params` | object |  | The action's parameters (validated with the record type's parameter rules). |
| `selection` | object | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`action` string · `params` object · `selection` object · `total` integer · `willApply` integer · `sample` object[] · `warnings` object[] · `consequences` string[] · `requiresReason` boolean · `requiresStepUp` boolean · `selectionToken` string · `entityType` string · `confirmationExpiresAt` string (date-time)

## Admin · Email

### GET `/api/v1/admin/email/deliveries`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Every e-mail delivery, newest first (e.g. ?status=FAILED&kind=TRANSACTIONAL for failed
invitations, activation and reset e-mails). Never returns message bodies (one-time links).

Returns `200` with no body.

### POST `/api/v1/admin/email/deliveries/{id}/retry`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Re-queue one FAILED delivery (transactional or bulk). Anything else: 409.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `201` with no body.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|

Returns `200` JSON with:

`completedAt` string (date-time) · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `createdBy` object · `failedCount` integer · `id` string (uuid) · `idempotencyKey` string · `sentCount` integer · `status` string · `subject` string · `totalRecipients` integer

|---|---|---|:-:|---|

Returns `201` JSON with:

`jobId` string (uuid) · `message` string · `requeued` integer

### POST `/api/v1/admin/email/send`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Queue a bulk e-mail. Returns the job immediately; sending happens in the
background. Re-using an idempotencyKey returns the original job
(`alreadyExisted: true`) instead of sending again.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `idempotencyKey` | string | ✓ | Idempotency key supplied by the caller. Re-submitting the same key returns the existing job rather than dispatching duplicate messages. Use a UUID or a stable hash. |
| `recipientMode` | EXPLICIT \| ROLE \| DIVISION \| SCHOOL \| ALL | ✓ |  |
| `recipientUserIds` | string[] |  | Required when recipientMode is EXPLICIT. Maximum 500 recipients per request. |
| `recipientRole` | string |  | Required when recipientMode is ROLE. Valid values: STUDENT | MENTOR | ADMIN |
| `recipientDivisionId` | string (uuid) |  | Required when recipientMode is DIVISION. |
| `recipientSchoolId` | string (uuid) |  | Required when recipientMode is SCHOOL. |
| `subject` | string | ✓ |  |
| `body` | string | ✓ | Plain-text message body. HTML is intentionally not supported to reduce XSS risk and simplify the implementation. Add HTML support here when needed. |

Returns `201` JSON with:

`alreadyExisted` boolean · `completedAt` any or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `createdBy` object · `dryRun` boolean · `failedCount` integer · `id` string (uuid) · `sentCount` integer · `status` string · `subject` string · `totalRecipients` integer

### GET `/api/v1/admin/email/users`

## Admin · Forms

### GET `/api/v1/admin/forms`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Every form with its mode, schedule, messages, computed state and who changed it last.

Returns `200` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/admin/forms/{key}`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `key` | path | STUDENT_REGISTRATION \| TEACHER_REGISTRATION \| COACH_APPLICATION \| CONTACT | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### PATCH `/api/v1/admin/forms/{key}/availability`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Open, close or schedule the form. 400 INVALID_FORM_SCHEDULE (SCHEDULED needs opensAt; closesAt after opensAt).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `key` | path | STUDENT_REGISTRATION \| TEACHER_REGISTRATION \| COACH_APPLICATION \| CONTACT | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `mode` | OPEN \| CLOSED \| SCHEDULED |  | OPEN (open now, until closesAt if set), CLOSED, or SCHEDULED (open from opensAt until closesAt). |
| `opensAt` | string |  | When a SCHEDULED form opens (required for SCHEDULED). null removes it. |
| `closesAt` | string |  | When the form closes (OPEN or SCHEDULED); null = no closing date. Must be after opensAt. |
| `requireEmailVerification` | boolean |  | Sign-up forms only (STUDENT_REGISTRATION, TEACHER_REGISTRATION, COACH_APPLICATION; 400 NOT_A_SIGN_UP_FORM otherwise): true — people who sign up with this form must confirm their e-mail (activation link) before they can sign in; false (the default) — no activation. Applies to accounts created from then on. |

Returns `200` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/admin/forms/{key}/history`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

The form's changes, newest first (audit rows; `limit` 1–200, default 50).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `key` | path | STUDENT_REGISTRATION \| TEACHER_REGISTRATION \| COACH_APPLICATION \| CONTACT | ✓ |  |
| `limit` | query | string |  |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### PATCH `/api/v1/admin/forms/{key}/messages`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Closed message, instructions, contact e-mail and support link (null or "" restores the default / removes).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `key` | path | STUDENT_REGISTRATION \| TEACHER_REGISTRATION \| COACH_APPLICATION \| CONTACT | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `closedMessage` | string |  | Shown while the form is closed (and returned with a refused submission). |
| `instructions` | string |  | Extra guidance shown with the form (open or closed). |
| `contactEmail` | string (email) |  |  |
| `supportUrl` | string (uri) |  | A support page; https only. |

Returns `200` with no body.

| `gradeLevel` | S1 \| S2 \| S3 \| S4 \| S5 \| S6 |  | Changing the grade moves a student to the matching division. |
| `schoolId` | string (uuid) |  | Omitted: the school is kept. A school id: the student moves to that school. null: the student's school is cleared (their current school claim ends; no new claim is created). |
| `schoolCode` | string |  | A Rwandan school by its official code — an alternative to schoolId (PR B). Given together, both must name the same school. |
| `homeLocation` | string |  |  |
| `homeCountry` | string |  | Home location (homeLocationRules; owner, 2026-11-20): the home country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, stored in `country`); with Rwanda the home province, district and sector are required (a place of the official directory, else 400 UNKNOWN_HOME_LOCATION); with another country they are not asked and the stored ones are cleared (sent anyway: 400 HOME_LOCATION_RWANDA_ONLY). The place is only accepted together with homeCountry (400 HOME_COUNTRY_REQUIRED). Separate from the school location. |
| `homeProvince` | string |  |  |
| `homeDistrict` | string |  |  |
| `homeSector` | string |  |  |
| `gender` | FEMALE \| MALE |  | Correct the account's gender (FEMALE or MALE; capability genderStep). Not audited with its value. |
| `olympiadInterests` | string[] |  | A Coach's Olympiad subject interests (capability coachOlympiadInterests), replacing the stored ones: one or more of MATHEMATICS, COMPUTING and PHYSICS, no duplicates. Coach (MENTOR) accounts only (400 INTERESTS_COACH_ONLY); the route already needs users.manage and the right to manage the account's role (users.manageCoaches). Information only: interests never grant marking or any other permission. |
| `olympiadInterestOther` | string |  | Another Olympiad named in words ("Other"; owner 2026-11-21; capability olympiadInterestOther), 2–100 characters, e.g. "Chemistry". With it, olympiadInterests may be empty. null clears it (only beside at least one subject). Never a subject: grants nothing, not part of Test Management. |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`accountStatus` string · `activatedAt` string (date-time) · `avatarUrl` any or null · `country` string or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `dateOfBirth` string (date-time) or null · `division` object or null · `email` string · `firstName` string · `gradeLevel` string or null · `guardianPhone` string or null · `homeDistrict` string or null · `homeLocation` any or null · `homeProvince` string or null · `homeSector` string or null · `id` string (uuid) · `isActive` boolean · `isApproved` boolean · `lastLoginAt` string (date-time) or null · `lastName` string · `olympiadInterests` any[] · `phone` string or null · `points` integer · `problemsSolved` integer · `provider` string · `role` string · `school` any or null · `updatedAt` string (date-time) · `username` string

for an account the caller may manage. Archive it instead (POST :id/status-changes, toStatus ARCHIVED).

| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### POST `/api/v1/admin/users/{id}/activate-now`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Activate now (capability adminActivateNow, owner 2026-11-24): an account "Awaiting setup" (never activated) whose
person chose their own password is activated at once, so they sign in without confirming their e-mail. Their unused
activation links stop working; audited ACTIVATE_ACCOUNT { via: 'admin' }; no e-mail is sent. Needs users.changeStatus
and the right to manage the account's role. 409 ALREADY_ACTIVATED / NO_PASSWORD_YET (resend the invitation instead) /
ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE (reactivate, lift or restore first), 400 CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_STATUS, 403 PERMISSION_REQUIRED /
ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE. Returns the account, `stillBlockedBy` (PENDING_APPROVAL, LOCKED, ROLE_DISABLED) and a message.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`message` string · `stillBlockedBy` string[] · `user` object

### POST `/api/v1/admin/users/{id}/status-changes`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Change an account's state (capability accountStates): ACTIVE, DEACTIVATED, SUSPENDED or ARCHIVED, with a reason
(3–500 characters; required except to reactivate or lift a suspension). Restoring an archived account also needs
`confirm: true`. Leaving ACTIVE ends every session. Returning to ACTIVE sets the state only; `stillBlockedBy` lists
what still prevents sign-in (NOT_ACTIVATED, PENDING_APPROVAL, LOCKED, ROLE_DISABLED).
Needs users.changeStatus, users.suspend or users.archive (by transition) and the right to manage the account's
role. 409 STATUS_UNCHANGED / INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION / LAST_SUPER_ADMIN, 400 REASON_REQUIRED /
CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_STATUS / CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, 403 PERMISSION_REQUIRED / ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `toStatus` | ACTIVE \| DEACTIVATED \| SUSPENDED \| ARCHIVED | ✓ |  |
| `reason` | string |  | Required (3–500 characters) to deactivate, suspend or archive, and to restore an archived account. |
| `confirm` | boolean |  | Must be true to restore an archived account (ARCHIVED → ACTIVE); ignored otherwise. |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`change` object · `stillBlockedBy` string[] · `user` object

### POST `/api/v1/auth/register/student`

**Access:** Public

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `firstName` | string | ✓ |  |
| `lastName` | string | ✓ |  |
| `username` | string | ✓ |  |
| `email` | string (email) | ✓ |  |
| `password` | string | ✓ |  |
| `gradeLevel` | S1 \| S2 \| S3 \| S4 \| S5 \| S6 | ✓ | S1–S3 places the student in the Junior division, S4–S6 in Senior. |
| `country` | string |  | Country of the school (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Default RW (Rwanda). Rwanda: the school comes from the official directory (schoolCode). Any other country: the school name is recorded as entered, unverified — never matched to a Rwandan school. |
| `schoolCode` | string |  | Rwanda: official code of the school attended (6 digits, from GET /schools/search or the Province → District → Sector listing). The student is linked to exactly that school. Required unless schoolId or schoolName is sent. |
| `schoolId` | string (uuid) |  | Rwanda (owner decision 2026-11-14): the internal id of the school attended, from GET /schools/search — how a school WITHOUT an official code is chosen (any school of the list may be chosen this way). It must be an active Rwandan school (400 UNKNOWN_SCHOOL, 409 SCHOOL_INACTIVE); the claim is PENDING exactly as with schoolCode. Not with schoolCode (400). schoolName and the place fields are ignored when it is sent. |
| `newSchoolCode` | string |  | A school WITHOUT an official code, chosen by schoolId (owner 2026-11-23): its 6-digit code is required (400 SCHOOL_CODE_REQUIRED) — the first digit is the school's province, and it must not be another school's (409 SCHOOL_CODE_TAKEN). The first valid code becomes the school's code at once (an Administrator corrects it later if needed). Ignored when the school already has a code. |
| `schoolName` | string |  | Another country: the school's name as entered (unverified; no school is linked). Rwanda, legacy (until the sign-up form sends schoolCode): it never creates a school and links the student only when it matches exactly one school of the official list — otherwise no school until an Administrator sets it. Ignored when schoolCode or schoolId is sent. |
| `schoolProvince` | string |  | Rwanda, "My school is not listed" (PR C): the school's place in the official directory, sent with schoolName — all three together (from GET /schools/locations). The claim keeps the name and place, PENDING until an Administrator matches and verifies it; an exact unique match with an active official school in that sector links that school (still PENDING). |
| `schoolDistrict` | string |  |  |
| `schoolSector` | string |  |  |
| `schoolLocation` | string |  | Legacy, with schoolName: city / region of the school (not stored). |
| `homeLocation` | string |  | Student's home city / region (optional free text, kept for older clients). With the official home place it is stored as "Sector, District" when not sent. Home location rules (homeLocationRules): homeCountry decides. |
| `dateOfBirth` | string | ✓ |  |
| `gender` | FEMALE \| MALE | ✓ | FEMALE or MALE. Required (owner, 2026-11-20: gender is asked at every sign-up). Not audited. |
| `phone` | string |  | The student's own phone (optional), stored in E.164 (teacher-application rules). Not audited. |
| `guardianPhone` | string | ✓ | A close-family member's phone, stored in E.164 (teacher-application rules). Required (owner decision 9.2, 2026-11-18: the server requires it, not only the form) — missing, empty or not a valid phone number is refused. Not audited. |
| `homeCountry` | string | ✓ | The student's home country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), stored in User.country. `country` stays the school's. Required (owner, 2026-11-20: home location on every registration form, homeLocationRules). |
| `homeProvince` | string |  | The official home place: required when homeCountry is Rwanda (a place of GET /schools/locations, else 400 UNKNOWN_HOME_LOCATION); with another homeCountry not asked (sent anyway: 400 HOME_LOCATION_RWANDA_ONLY). |
| `homeDistrict` | string |  |  |
| `homeSector` | string |  |  |
| `olympiadInterests` | string[] |  | Olympiads the student is interested in (owner decision 8): one or more of MATHEMATICS, COMPUTING and PHYSICS, no duplicates (capability studentOlympiadInterests). Optional for older clients (the account then has none); the sign-up form requires at least one. Information only: no programme membership, no permissions. |
| `olympiadInterestOther` | string |  | Another Olympiad named in words ("Other"; owner 2026-11-21; capability olympiadInterestOther), 2–100 characters, e.g. "Chemistry". With it, olympiadInterests may be empty. null clears it (only beside at least one subject). Never a subject: grants nothing, not part of Test Management. |

Returns `201` JSON with:

`avatarUrl` any or null · `country` string or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `dateOfBirth` string (date-time) or null · `division` object · `email` string · `firstName` string · `gradeLevel` string · `guardianPhone` string or null · `homeDistrict` string or null · `homeLocation` string · `homeProvince` string or null · `homeSector` string or null · `id` string (uuid) · `lastLoginAt` any or null · `lastName` string · `olympiadInterests` string[] · `phone` string or null · `points` integer · `problemsSolved` integer · `requiresApproval` boolean · `requiresEmailVerification` boolean · `role` string · `school` object or null · `schoolVerification` string or null · `username` string

`message` string

### POST `/api/v1/auth/view-as/end`

**Access:** Public

End the viewing session of the bearer viewing token (also after it expired). Audited (VIEW_AS_ENDED). Never
touches the viewer's own session or cookie. Idempotent; 200 also when there was nothing to end.

Returns `200` with no body.

### POST `/api/v1/auth/view-as/exchange`

**Access:** Public

Exchange a ticket (once, within 60 seconds) for a viewing access token: { accessToken, tokenType, expiresAt,
viewAs: { sessionId, actor, target, expiresAt } }. 30 minutes, no refresh token, no cookie; every change is refused
with it (403 VIEW_AS_READ_ONLY). 403 VIEW_AS_NOT_ALLOWED for an unknown, used or expired ticket.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `ticket` | string | ✓ | The single-use ticket returned by POST /admin/users/:id/view-as. |

Returns `200` with no body.

### PATCH `/api/v1/me`

**Access:** STUDENT, TEACHER, MENTOR, HEAD_COACH, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `firstName` | string |  |  |
| `lastName` | string |  |  |
| `homeLocation` | string |  |  |
| `homeCountry` | string |  | Home location (homeLocationRules; owner, 2026-11-20): the home country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, stored in `country`); with Rwanda the home province, district and sector are required (a place of the official directory, else 400 UNKNOWN_HOME_LOCATION); with another country they are not asked and the stored ones are cleared (sent anyway: 400 HOME_LOCATION_RWANDA_ONLY). The place is only accepted together with homeCountry (400 HOME_COUNTRY_REQUIRED). Separate from the school location. |
| `homeProvince` | string |  |  |
| `homeDistrict` | string |  |  |
| `homeSector` | string |  |  |
| `olympiadInterests` | string[] |  | The caller's Olympiad interests (owner decision 8), replacing the stored ones: one or more of MATHEMATICS, COMPUTING and PHYSICS, no duplicates (capability studentOlympiadInterests). |
| `olympiadInterestOther` | string |  | Another Olympiad named in words ("Other"; owner 2026-11-21; capability olympiadInterestOther), 2–100 characters, e.g. "Chemistry". With it, olympiadInterests may be empty. null clears it (only beside at least one subject). Never a subject: grants nothing, not part of Test Management. |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`avatarUrl` any or null · `country` string or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `dateOfBirth` string (date-time) or null · `division` object · `email` string · `firstName` string · `gradeLevel` string · `guardianPhone` string or null · `homeDistrict` string or null · `homeLocation` string · `homeProvince` string or null · `homeSector` string or null · `id` string (uuid) · `lastLoginAt` string (date-time) · `lastName` string · `olympiadInterests` string[] · `phone` string or null · `points` integer · `problemsSolved` integer · `role` string · `school` object · `username` string

### GET `/api/v1/me/assignments`

**Access:** STUDENT

Every assignment for the student's division with my display status. Filters: q, courseId,
academicYearId, deadlineFrom/To, progress (my status, incl. OVERDUE); sort: deadline | -deadline
| title (capability studentAssignmentFilters).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `courseId` | query | string |  |  |
| `divisionId` | query | string |  | Mentors/admins only. |
| `status` | query | ARCHIVED \| DRAFT \| PUBLISHED \| CLOSED \| PENDING_APPROVAL \| REJECTED |  | Mentors/admins only. |
| `statuses` | query | array |  | Several statuses at once (comma-separated, e.g. DRAFT,REJECTED), so a list that groups statuses pages in the database. Not together with `status`. |
| `academicYearId` | query | string |  |  |
| `createdById` | query | string |  | Mentors/admins only: assignments prepared by this mentor. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Search title, description and instructions. |
| `deadlineFrom` | query | string |  | Deadline on or after this instant. |
| `deadlineTo` | query | string |  | Deadline on or before this instant. |
| `progress` | query | NOT_STARTED \| SUBMITTED \| PENDING_REVIEW \| RESUBMISSION_REQUESTED \| REVIEWED \| OVERDUE |  | Only assignments where my progress is this (paging and totals count the matches). |
| `sort` | query | deadline \| -deadline \| title |  | deadline (soonest first, the default), -deadline (latest first) or title (A–Z). |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`data` object[] · `meta` object

REQUIRED for every new application (owner decision 2026-11-19, capability coachOlympiadInterests). Copied to the Coach account on approval; information only — it never grants marking or any other permission. |

### POST `/api/v1/public/subscribe`

**Access:** Public

Subscribe to ROF news. Always the same 202 answer — new address, already subscribed or unsubscribed before (which
subscribes it again) — so the answer never tells whether an address is on the list. At most 10 per hour per IP.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `email` | string (email) | ✓ |  |
| `fullName` | string |  |  |
| `kind` | STUDENT \| TEACHER \| OTHER \| PARENT \| SCHOOL |  |  |
| `interests` | string[] |  | None chosen = every subject. |
| `country` | string |  |  |
| `website` | string |  | Honeypot: hidden from people; when filled in the request is accepted silently and nothing is stored. |

Returns `202` JSON with:

`message` string · `received` boolean

### POST `/api/v1/public/unsubscribe`

**Access:** Public

The unsubscribe page's button: `id` and `token` from the link in every e-mail. Idempotent. Invalid link → 400.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | string | ✓ | The subscriber id from the link (`s`). Not validated as a UUID so every malformed link gets the same answer. |
| `token` | string | ✓ | The token from the link (`t`). |
| `reason` | string |  |  |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`unsubscribed` boolean

### POST `/api/v1/public/unsubscribe/one-click`

**Access:** Public

RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe (List-Unsubscribe-Post): mail clients POST "List-Unsubscribe=One-Click" to the URL in
the List-Unsubscribe header. The subscriber and token are in the query string; the body is not read.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `s` | query | string | ✓ |  |
| `t` | query | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`unsubscribed` boolean

## Teacher

### GET `/api/v1/teacher/schools`

**Access:** TEACHER

Teachers only: the schools an Administrator has assigned to you, and whether you are the school's primary teacher
(its designated main contact; role PRIMARY) or a secondary teacher. The same rights either way. Other roles: 403.

Returns `200` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/teacher/students`

**Access:** TEACHER

Teachers only: every registered student of the schools an Administrator has assigned to you
(active school assignments) — name, username, grade, division, school. Other roles: 403.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `schoolId` | query | string |  | One of the teacher's schools (default: all of them). |
| `gradeLevel` | query | S1 \| S2 \| S3 \| S4 \| S5 \| S6 |  |  |
| `q` | query | string |  | Name or username contains. |
| `access` | query | SCHOOL \| ASSIGNED |  | How the teacher sees them: SCHOOL (verified students of their schools) or ASSIGNED (assigned to them). |

Returns `200` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/teacher/students/{id}`

**Access:** TEACHER

A student of your assigned schools, or assigned to you: profile and account status, no contact details. Needs the students.viewProfile delegation covering this student.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

**Access:** TEACHER

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### POST `/api/v1/teacher/students/{id}/submissions`

**Access:** TEACHER

Submit for a student of your assigned schools (multipart, as POST /submissions). Needs the
submissions.submitOnBehalf delegation. The student stays the owner; you are recorded as the submitter.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (multipart/form-data):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `assignmentId` | string (uuid) | ✓ | The published assignment being submitted to. |
| `answerText` | string |  | The student's typed answer for this attempt. |
| `note` | string |  | Optional note from the student about this submission/revision. |

Returns `201` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/teacher/students/summary`

**Access:** TEACHER

Teachers only: how many students you see (through your schools, through assignments) and how many of your schools' students are waiting for verification (a number only).

Returns `200` with no body.

## Tests · Marking

### GET `/api/v1/marking/queue`

**Access:** MENTOR

My marking queue: ?state=NOT_STARTED|IN_PROGRESS|MARKED, ?testId; counts and progress per test. Paginated.

|---|---|---|:-:|---|

### GET `/api/v1/marking/submissions/{code}`

**Access:** MENTOR

One assigned submission by its code: the test, questions, the answer (pages under neutral names) and my marking.

|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `code` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### PUT `/api/v1/marking/submissions/{code}/marking`

**Access:** MENTOR

Save my draft: { scores?: [{ questionId, marks?, comment? }], totalMarks?, comment?, expectedRevision? } — whole marks,
never above the maxima. 400 MARKS_*, QUESTION_NOT_IN_TEST, TOTAL_NOT_ALLOWED, SCORES_NOT_ALLOWED; 409 MARKING_SUBMITTED,
MARKING_CHANGED, INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `code` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `scores` | object[] |  |  |
| `totalMarks` | number |  | Tests without questions: whole marks, 0 to the test's maximum. |
| `comment` | string |  |  |
| `expectedRevision` | number |  | Optional: the revision the marker started from; another one now → 409 MARKING_CHANGED. |

Returns `200` with no body.

## Tests · Students

### GET `/api/v1/me/tests`

**Access:** STUDENT

My tests: ?window=UPCOMING|OPEN|CLOSED; each with my deadline, window, submission summary and canSubmit. Paginated.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `window` | query | UPCOMING \| OPEN \| CLOSED |  | UPCOMING, OPEN or CLOSED (database time; the deadline includes any extension). |

Returns `200` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/me/tests/{id}`

**Access:** STUDENT

The test (questions once open), my deadline, my submission with every version. 404 TEST_NOT_FOUND (draft, other division).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/me/tests/{id}/paper`

**Access:** STUDENT

The test paper (neutral name), once the test opened. 409 TEST_NOT_OPEN; 404 TEST_FILE_NOT_FOUND.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |
| `download` | query | string |  |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### POST `/api/v1/me/tests/{id}/submission`

**Access:** STUDENT

Submit (first time) or replace (a new version; every version is kept): { clientKey, typedAnswer?, pageCount? }.
The same clientKey again returns the same version (replayed: true). 400 TYPED_ANSWER_REQUIRED, PAGES_REQUIRED,
TYPED_ANSWER_NOT_ALLOWED, UPLOAD_NOT_ALLOWED, ANSWER_REQUIRED; 409 DEADLINE_PASSED, PAGES_INCOMPLETE, TEST_NOT_OPEN.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `clientKey` | string (uuid) | ✓ | A UUID the client generates once per attempt; also the key its pages were uploaded under. |
| `typedAnswer` | string |  | The typed answer (up to 50 000 characters), when the format allows it. |
| `pageCount` | number |  | How many pages the client uploaded under clientKey (1…30); 409 PAGES_INCOMPLETE when some are missing. |

Returns `201` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/me/tests/{id}/uploads/{uploadKey}`

**Access:** STUDENT

Pages uploaded under :uploadKey and not yet submitted.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |
| `uploadKey` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### POST `/api/v1/me/tests/{id}/uploads/{uploadKey}/pages/{page}`

**Access:** STUDENT

Upload ONE page (multipart field `file`; PDF or image, 20 MB) as page :page of the upload :uploadKey; the same page
again replaces it. 400 UPLOAD_NOT_ALLOWED (typed-only test), TOO_MANY_PAGES; 409 DEADLINE_PASSED, TEST_NOT_OPEN,
UPLOAD_ALREADY_SUBMITTED; 415 FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |
| `uploadKey` | path | string | ✓ |  |
| `page` | path | number | ✓ |  |

Returns `201` with no body.

### DELETE `/api/v1/me/tests/{id}/uploads/{uploadKey}/pages/{page}`

**Access:** STUDENT

Remove a pending page. 404 PAGE_NOT_FOUND (also for a submitted page: those never change).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |
| `uploadKey` | path | string | ✓ |  |
| `page` | path | number | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/me/tests/{id}/versions/{versionId}/pages/{page}`

**Access:** STUDENT

A page of one of my versions (page-3.jpg …).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |
| `versionId` | path | string | ✓ |  |
| `page` | path | number | ✓ |  |
| `download` | query | string |  |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

## Users

### GET `/api/v1/users/{id}/avatar`

**Access:** STUDENT, TEACHER, MENTOR, HEAD_COACH, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

The account's current profile picture, inline, with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. A staff account's picture:
any signed-in user (Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400; the link in avatarUrl is versioned). A student's
picture: the student, Administrators, and a Teacher who may view that student's profile (Cache-Control: private,
no-store) — anyone else gets 404, the same as an account without a picture.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.
